violations.reason: At step 27, the agent states that a credit card refund for the returned bicycle "typically takes 5–7 business days after the return is processed to appear on your card." The Return delivered order policy and the return_delivered_order_items tool contract only provide that the order status will change to "return requested" and that the user will receive an email with return instructions; neither provides a timeline for the refund to appear on a credit card. The agent therefore supplied information not provided by the user or the tools.
